Our story

A small guesthouse, run by the family who live here

Rock Side Inn sits on the hillside just above Ella — close enough that town is a six-minute walk downhill, far enough that what you hear at night is the valley rather than the main street.

Ten rooms, a garden, a shared lounge, and a terrace pointed straight at Ella Rock.

Dumindu and the family look after the place themselves: meeting the early train, cooking the rice and curry, and pointing out which trail to take before the cloud rolls in.

Ten rooms, every one with a balcony

Our view

A terrace pointed straight at Ella Rock

Hammocks strung for the afternoon, and the whole rock face turning gold at sunset — the view is the reason the house was built here.

Kitchen & bar

Sri Lankan cooking, served on the terrace

The restaurant runs all day — a continental or Sri Lankan breakfast to start, then kottu, fried rice, rotti, soups, devilled dishes and rice and curry through to the evening.

Things to do

Ella, straight from the doorstep

The trail up Ella Rock starts a few minutes from our gate — and we’ll have breakfast packed if you’re leaving before sunrise.

Minutes from the gate

Ella Rock

Ask at the desk which path to take before the cloud rolls in.

Every evening

Sunset from the balcony

The whole rock face turns gold — best with a cold drink from the bar.

2–3 km

Nine Arch Bridge & Little Adam's Peak

Walk through the tea fields or take a tuk-tuk from the gate. We keep the train times at the desk.
